title: Mystra's Grace

sources.title: Feather Fall
markers: | summary = It allows spellcasters to make themselves and their allies light as a feather, preventing damage when falling from extreme heights.

summary: Cast Feather Fall at will as a Bonus Action while wearing the boots.

fields.Feather Fall: You and allies within 30 ft are immune to falling damage for 10 turns. Also prevents being knocked Prone from a drop over about 26 ft. No Concentration.
fields.Acquisition: In the Chest of the Mundane on the Arcane Tower’s north balcony, on the level with the turrets.
fields.Base value: 70 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
